lines.en: label dormwarsfive3:
scene sky
Imani Imai slept well that night, but she had to do it alone. At least the second and third times.
lines.zh: Imani Imai 那晚睡得不错，只不过她是独自睡的。至少第二次和第三次是。

lines.en: The first time was in the arms of her best friend. It lasted for approximately three hours and nine minutes. It was the largest of all three blocks of sleep she’d get that night.
lines.zh: 第一次是在她最好的朋友怀里。那一段大约持续了三小时零九分钟，是她那晚三段睡眠中最长的一段。

lines.en: She’d drifted in and out, yes. But never for long enough to put any sizable dent in the regular six hours she’d always try to get before starting the next day.
lines.zh: 她确实断断续续地醒过。但从没有久到能在她每天开始前总要凑够的六小时常规睡眠上，凿出一个像样的缺口。

lines.en: Between blocks one and two — when she’d wake and find that her best friend was no longer beside her — she’d sigh and think to herself, “that makes sense.”
lines.zh: 在第一段和第二段之间——当她醒来，发现最好的朋友已不在身侧——她会叹一口气，心里想着，「这也是意料之中。」

lines.en: She never expected him to stay. She just wanted him to.
lines.zh: 她从没指望他会留下。她只是希望他会。

lines.en: She wanted a lot of things, though. A car. A nicer apartment. A raise. An answer to at least one of several questions she had about some dialogue during a roleplay last night.
lines.zh: 不过她想要的东西还有很多。一辆车。一间更好的公寓。一次加薪。还有昨晚一场角色扮演里某几句台词留下的、若干问题中至少一个的答案。

lines.en: But she had learned throughout her life that the solution to most problems is usually just time.
lines.zh: 但她在人生中学到的是，大多数问题的解决办法通常只是时间。

lines.en: So she’d worry about all of those things later.
lines.zh: 所以那些事，她以后再操心。

lines.en: And for now-
lines.zh: 而现在——

lines.en: She’d be needed in at least one way.
lines.zh: 至少会有一种方式需要她。

lines.en: : LADIES AND GENTLEMEN!
lines.zh: : 女士们，先生们！

lines.en: scene poolcook1
: AND ALSO MOLLY EVEN THOUGH SHE’S NOT HERE!
lines.zh: : 还有 Molly，尽管她不在这儿！

lines.en: : Ahh, but what if she is, Uta? What if she’s one of our millions of viewers tuning in from home?!
lines.zh: : 啊，可万一她在呢，Uta？万一她是我们千百万名在家收看的观众之一呢？！

lines.en: : Then she’s going to have a very bad time because our contract wasn’t renewed and this year’s Dorm Wars isn’t being broadcast at all!
lines.zh: : 那她今天可要倒大霉了，因为我们的合约没续签，今年的宿舍战争根本不转播！

lines.en: scene poolcook2
: Then why are we holding microphones?! And why did you wait until right now to tell me that?!
lines.zh: : 那我们为什么还举着麦克风？！还有你为什么非得等到现在才告诉我？！

lines.en: : Because it wouldn’t be Dorm Wars if I didn’t get to yell really early in the morning and Makoto didn’t want to do it with me!
lines.zh: : 因为如果我不能在一大早就扯着嗓子喊，那就不是宿舍战争了！而且 Makoto 不肯陪我一起喊！

lines.en: : I understand! I also struggle finding people to yell with early in the morning! But do you know what I don’t struggle with, Uta?!
lines.zh: : 我懂！我也很难找到愿意一大早就陪我一起喊的人！但你知道什么是我不觉得难的吗，Uta？！

lines.en: : Sensei’s penis!
lines.zh: : Sensei 的鸡巴！

lines.en: scene poolcook3
: Cooking!
lines.zh: : 做饭！

lines.en: : And also Sensei’s penis.
lines.zh: : 还有 Sensei 的鸡巴。

lines.en: scene poolcook4
: I’m not going to comment on that. But what I will do instead is ask you to give us a breakdown of the current situation, Uta.
lines.zh: : 这个我不予置评。我要做的是请你给我们讲讲目前的状况，Uta。

lines.en: : Because, at least from what I understand, this contest was originally scheduled to take place on the beach instead of in the school’s pool room.
lines.zh: : 因为，至少据我所知，这场比赛原本是定在海滩上举行的，而不是学校的泳池房。

lines.en: : That’s right, Ayane. We had a helicopter from the Tsukioka Foundation prepared to go and everything.
lines.zh: : 没错，Ayane。我们连 Tsukioka 财团的直升机都准备好了，万事俱备。

lines.en: : But as it turns out, an unexpected “tidal disaster” has laid waste to the beach! And it won’t be fixed up for at least two months.
lines.zh: : 但结果呢，一场突如其来的「潮汐灾难」把海滩给毁了！而且至少要两个月才能修好。

lines.en: scene poolcook5
: A tidal disaster, you say?
lines.zh: : 你说是潮汐灾难？

lines.en: : Right again. But I’m sure it won’t be the only disaster we talk about today as we’ve got one hell of a contest coming up, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 又说对了。不过我敢肯定，那不会是我们今天谈到的唯一一场灾难，因为接下来有一场要命的比赛，Ayane。

lines.en: scene poolcook6
: In just a few minutes, the Dragon of Kumon-mi High will take on everyone’s second-best friend, Noriko Nakayama! And at least one of them is expected to fail miserably.
lines.zh: : 几分钟之后，Kumon-mi 高中的龙将迎战大家的第二好朋友 Noriko Nakayama！而其中至少有一人被预期会以惨败收场。

lines.en: : Now, it is possible Yumi surprises us despite being the clear underdog in the competition. But we won’t know until we really get into things.
lines.zh: : 当然，Yumi 也有可能让我们大吃一惊，尽管她在这场比赛中明显处于劣势。但在真正开始之前我们不会知道。

lines.en: : Which, based on telepathic communications I am currently receiving, is right now! Take it away, Imani!
lines.zh: : 而根据我此刻接收到的心灵感应，就是现在！交给你了，Imani！

lines.en: scene poolcook7
: Thanks, Uta. As you can see, I’m live with Yumi and Noriko — the first contestants of the fifth annual Dorm Wars!
lines.zh: : 谢了，Uta。如你所见，我现在正和 Yumi 与 Noriko 在一起——第五届宿舍战争的首批参赛选手！

lines.en: : Who are you talking to? There’s nobody there.
lines.zh: : 你在跟谁说话？那儿一个人都没有。

lines.en: : Sure as fuck better not be anybody there. You’ve already talked me into wearing this bullshit. I ain’t tryin’ to put myself on display.
lines.zh: : 最好那儿真的一个人都没有。你都已经说服我穿上这身蠢东西了，我可不想再被人参观。

lines.en: scene poolcook8
: You should. You’re really hot and I want you to have more confidence in yourself.
lines.zh: : 你应该的。你真的很辣，我希望你能对自己多点自信。

lines.en: : You’re also a member of the swim club, so I’m not really sure what you mean by “this bullshit.”
lines.zh: : 而且你还是游泳部的成员，所以我不太明白你说的「这身蠢东西」是什么意思。

lines.en: scene poolcook7
: But that doesn’t matter because we’ve got a game to play and you guys are going to be the ones playing it!
lines.zh: : 不过那不重要，因为我们有比赛要打，而上场的就是你们俩！

lines.en: : Now, the rules are simple. The two of you have fifteen minutes to make the “perfect omelet.”
lines.zh: : 现在，规则很简单。你们有十五分钟做出一份「完美的煎蛋卷」。

lines.en: : How you interpret that is completely up to you — and you’re both encouraged to exercise your creativity in any way you can.
lines.zh: : 怎么理解随你们的便——我们鼓励你们以任何方式释放自己的创造力。

lines.en: : How many fuckin’ ways can somebody interpret “perfect omelet?” It’s just fuckin’ eggs and...ain’t that literally all it is? Just eggs?
lines.zh: : 「完美煎蛋卷」能有他妈几种理解？不就是他妈的鸡蛋吗……难道它真的就只是鸡蛋？就只是蛋？

lines.en: scene poolcook9
: Omelets have other stuff, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 煎蛋卷里还有别的东西呢，Yumi。

lines.en: : What the fuck is it called when it’s just eggs then?
lines.zh: : 那只有蛋的话，那玩意儿他妈叫什么？

lines.en: : I believe that would be called “eggs.”
lines.zh: : 我想那应该叫「蛋」。

lines.en: : You really are an underdog here, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你在这里确实是弱势方啊，不是吗？

lines.en: scene poolcook10
: I never said I expected to win, okay?! Chika does all the fucking cooking! Or...did...all the fucking cooking. Shut up! I’m just here for the free food!
lines.zh: : 我又没说我觉得自己能赢，行了吧？！Chika 才是负责他妈做饭的那个！或者说……以前……是负责他妈做饭的那个。闭嘴！我只是来蹭免费食物的！

lines.en: : She’s a growing girl. She needs to eat so she’ll grow up big and strong.
lines.zh: : 她还在长身体呢。需要吃饭才能长得又高又壮。

lines.en: scene poolcook11
: You could stand to eat every once in a while too. Could see your fuckin’ ribs in the locker room ten minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 你也该偶尔吃点东西。十分钟前在更衣室都能看见你的肋骨了。

lines.en: : Awww, she was looking at me in the locker room. We really are in love.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，她在更衣室看我。我们真的是坠入爱河了。

lines.en: scene poolcook12
: Right! Well, assuming there are no other questions, why don’t we round up your partners and begin the contest?!
lines.zh: : 好！那么，假设没有其他问题了，我们不如把你们的搭档叫过来，开始比赛吧？！

lines.en: scene poolcook13
: Partner?
lines.zh: : 搭档？

lines.en: : Did you not even read the email? Both teams get a partner from their floor to serve as an omelet advisor.
lines.zh: : 你连邮件都没看吗？两队各从本楼层选一名搭档，担任煎蛋卷顾问。

lines.en: : I have an email address? What is it?
lines.zh: : 我有邮箱地址？是什么？

lines.en: : If you manage to win here, it’s going to be the upset of the century.
lines.zh: : 如果你能在这儿赢下来，那就是本世纪最大的冷门。

lines.en: : It’s just an omelet. Why would we need an advisor in the first place?
lines.zh: : 就只是个煎蛋卷而已。我们为什么还需要顾问？

lines.en: : Obviously because of people like Yumi who don’t seem to even understand what an omelet is.
lines.zh: : 显然是因为有 Yumi 这种看起来连煎蛋卷是什么都不懂的人。

lines.en: : Don’t matter to me as long as I can eat it.
lines.zh: : 只要能吃就行，我不在乎。

lines.en: scene black
: Works for me! And I’m sure it would work for our viewers too if we had any!
lines.zh: : 我没意见！而且如果我们有观众的话，我相信他们也会没意见的！

lines.en: : We’ll have some later! My friends are coming back for Death Ball! They’re going to watch from the roof though so they don’t accidentally die.
lines.zh: : 以后会有的！我的朋友们会回来看死亡球！不过他们会从屋顶上看，免得一不小心死了。

lines.en: : If they do, it will just mean the game was successful.
lines.zh: : 如果真死了，那只能说明比赛成功了。

lines.en: : Praise be to the ball of death!
lines.zh: : 赞美死亡之球！

lines.en: : Contestants! On your marks!
lines.zh: : 选手们！各就各位！

lines.en: : Get set...
lines.zh: : 预备……

lines.en: : EGG TIME MADNESS!
lines.zh: : 鸡蛋疯狂时间！

lines.en: scene poolcook14
: Right off the bat, Yumi reaches for the bell peppers! Could it be that she has already learned the ways of the omelet?!
lines.zh: : 一上来，Yumi 就伸手去拿青椒！难道她已经领悟了煎蛋卷之道？！

lines.en: : Okay. Must be doin’ somethin’ right if this is apparently the way of the omelet.
lines.zh: : 好吧。如果这真是煎蛋卷之道，那我肯定做对了什么。

lines.en: : The fuck am I supposed to do with these things, though?
lines.zh: : 可这些东西我该他妈怎么处理啊？

lines.en: : Uh-oh! Sounds like Yumi should have checked her emails! An advisor would sure come in handy right now, wouldn’t they?
lines.zh: : 哎呀糟了！听起来 Yumi 应该先去看看她的邮件！这时候有个顾问就很管用了，对吧？

lines.en: scene poolcook15
: Blondie! Give me some fuckin’ advice! Ain’t nobody else from the first floor here right now!
lines.zh: : 金发妹！给我点他妈的建议！一楼现在没有别人在啊！

lines.en: : Yeah, the turnout for the opening contest is really low this year. I hope everybody else checked their email and didn’t ride Touka’s helicopter into the tidal disaster.
lines.zh: : 是啊，今年开场赛的到场人数真低。希望其他人都查了邮件，别是坐着 Touka 的直升机冲进潮汐灾难里了。

lines.en: : Imani, am I allowed to help Yumi? Or-
lines.zh: : Imani，我可以帮助 Yumi 吗？还是——

lines.en: : Unfortunately not, Ayane. The contract you signed upon agreeing to be a commentator prohibits you from helping either of the contestants.
lines.zh: : 恐怕不行，Ayane。你签下同意担任解说员的合同，禁止你帮助任何一方选手。

lines.en: : Help me anyway! The punishment can’t be that bad!
lines.zh: : 反正帮我一下嘛！惩罚能有多严重！

lines.en: : The punishment is death.
lines.zh: : 惩罚是死刑。

lines.en: : Blondie! Kill yourself to help me! Which one of these colors tastes better?!
lines.zh: : 金发妹！为了帮我去死吧！这几种颜色哪个更好吃？！

lines.en: scene poolcook16
: Wow. Yumi’s even more hopeless in the kitchen than I would have imagined.
lines.zh: : 哇。Yumi 在厨房里比我预想的还要没救。

lines.en: : Focus, Pink Psion of the Palace of Pinkerton.
lines.zh: : 专注，Pinkerton 宫殿的粉色念力师。

lines.en: scene poolcook17
: Sorry, are you talking to me?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你是在跟我说话吗？

lines.en: : I see no other pink. Now heed these words as they are the most important you will ever hear. I hold in my hands the key to the perfect omelet.
lines.zh: : 我没看见别的粉色。现在听好这些话，因为这是你此生听到的最重要的话。我手中握着的，是完美煎蛋卷的钥匙。

lines.en: : This, Psion...
lines.zh: : 这个，念力师……

lines.en: : This is an egg.
lines.zh: : 这是一颗蛋。

lines.en: : That’s it? That’s the advice?
lines.zh: : 就这？这就是你的建议？

lines.en: : I have learned through experience that no one ever listens when I provide cooking advice, so I have decided to dumb it down to levels somewhat inconceivable.
lines.zh: : 凭经验我发现，每当我给出烹饪建议，从来没人听。所以我决定把它简化到某种难以置信的程度。

lines.en: : You may now ask me two questions about eggs.
lines.zh: : 现在你可以问我两个关于蛋的问题。

lines.en: : I don’t have any questions, Tsuneyo. I know how to make an omelet.
lines.zh: : 我没有任何问题，Tsuneyo。我会做煎蛋卷。

lines.en: scene poolcook18
: Wow. My new methods work quite flawlessly. Perhaps this is how I should have been teaching all along?
lines.zh: : 哇。我的新方法效果相当完美。也许这才是我一直该用的教学方式？

lines.en: : Noriko! Hi.
lines.zh: : Noriko！你好。

lines.en: : Seeing as you have the time and aren’t currently fighting an internal battle about which bell pepper to use in an omelet, can you tell us a little about your strategy today?
lines.zh: : 既然你现在有空，又不用为了煎蛋卷里该放哪种青椒而进行内心斗争，能跟我们讲讲你今天的策略吗？

lines.en: : I don’t really have one.
lines.zh: : 我其实没什么策略。

lines.en: : Can you come up with one then? Because it’s kind of hard to commentate on a competition where neither girl is doing anything.
lines.zh: : 那你能临时想一个吗？因为两个女生什么都不做，这比赛实在很难解说。

lines.en: scene poolcook19
: We’re only like thirty seconds in. And besides, I try not to use eggs if I don’t literally have to.
lines.zh: : 我们才刚开始三十秒而已。而且再说，如果不是非用不可，我尽量不用蛋。

lines.en: : In what situation would one literally have to use eggs?
lines.zh: : 什么情况下是非用蛋不可？

lines.en: : Reproduction.
lines.zh: : 繁殖。

lines.en: : Reproduction and this contest, Noriko! This is the easiest win possible! You’re on my team! Just throw an egg on the grill at this rate and you'll have the competition in the bag. And also the grill.
lines.zh: : 繁殖，还有这场比赛，Noriko！这是最容易拿下的胜利了！你可是我这边的！照这个速度，你随便往烤架上扔个蛋，比赛就稳了。连烤架一起稳了。

lines.en: : Why do we even have grills? Who cooks an omelet on a barbecue grill?
lines.zh: : 我们为什么会有烤架啊？谁会用烧烤架做煎蛋卷？

lines.en: : I asked the same question when Geoffrey was dropping them off but he had to go save a princess from a burning building before he was able to answer.
lines.zh: : Geoffrey 送过来的时候我也问了同样的问题，但他得赶去从着火的大楼里救一位公主，所以没来得及回答。

lines.en: : Cook, woman! Yumi is still choosing a pepper!
lines.zh: : 做饭啊，女人！Yumi 还在挑青椒呢！

lines.en: scene poolcook20
: Fuck! Why is cooking so hard?!
lines.zh: : 操！做饭为什么这么难？！

lines.en: : Still?! Yumi, just choose one!
lines.zh: : 还在挑？！Yumi，随便挑一个！

lines.en: : No! This is the fuckin’ blobfish all over again! I bet these things are only here as a trick and that usin’ ‘em just gets our points docked!
lines.zh: : 不要！这又是他妈的水滴鱼事件重演！我敢说这些东西摆在这儿就是个陷阱，用了就扣分！

lines.en: : Then put them down!
lines.zh: : 那就放下它们！

lines.en: scene poolcook21
: Okay! Then what?!
lines.zh: : 好！然后呢？！

lines.en: : Oh my fucking God. Hold on.
lines.zh: : 我操你妈的。等等。

lines.en: : Noriko! What are you-
lines.zh: : Noriko！你在——

lines.en: scene poolcook22
: Use the green one. I like them more. They’re essentially the same exact thing as the red ones, just a little less ripe so you get an earthier, grassy taste with them.
lines.zh: : 用绿色的。我更喜欢绿的。它们和红的其实基本是一回事，只是没那么熟，所以会带点更泥土、更青草的味道。

lines.en: : Uh...th...thanks?
lines.zh: : 呃……谢……谢谢？

lines.en: : What’s this?! Is Noriko Yumi’s omelet advisor now?! Imani! Check the rules! Do we have to kill her?!
lines.zh: : 这是什么情况？！难道 Noriko 现在是 Yumi 的煎蛋卷顾问了吗？！Imani！查一下规则！我们得杀了她吗？！

lines.en: : Negative, Ayane! We’ve never seen anything like this before! Who could have ever predicted that one floor would help the other?!
lines.zh: : 不必，Ayane！我们从未见过这种事！谁能预料到一个楼层会去帮另一个楼层？！

lines.en: : Me because Noriko’s too fucking nice! Noriko! Get back over here and make an omelet before we lose!
lines.zh: : 我就预料到了，因为 Noriko 他妈的太善良了！Noriko！给我滚回来做煎蛋卷，不然我们要输了！

lines.en: scene poolcook23
: No! I’m on Yumi’s team now! Go Yumi!
lines.zh: : 不要！我现在是 Yumi 这边的人了！加油，Yumi！

lines.en: : Uhh...as much as I appreciate the help, you really ain’t gotta take the fall for me. I’ll just fuckin’ use both of ’em with some eggs and, like...I don’t know...milk?
lines.zh: : 呃……虽然我很感谢你的帮助，但你真不用为我背这个锅。我就把两种都跟蛋、还有……比如……牛奶一起用了吧？

lines.en: scene poolcook24
: It’s true that milk can make eggs fluffier, sure. But did you know that it might also contain pus from mastitis — an infection of the cow’s udders?
lines.zh: : 牛奶确实能让蛋更蓬松，没错。但你知道它也可能含有乳腺炎——也就是奶牛乳房感染——产生的脓吗？

lines.en: : Ew. Don’t ruin milk for me, please.
lines.zh: : 呕。求你别毁掉牛奶。

lines.en: : I can ruin a lot of things for you. I’m just not going to because I believe forcing one’s ideals upon another is a very rude thing to do.
lines.zh: : 我能毁掉你很多东西。只是我不会去做，因为我认为把自己的观念强加给别人是非常无礼的事。

lines.en: : So you’ll just...subtly and sneakily ruin them then.
lines.zh: : 所以你会……不动声色、偷偷摸摸地毁掉它们。

lines.en: scene poolcook25
: Maybe every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 也许偶尔吧。

lines.en: : Noriko, go back to your table. I know you’re too nice to not help me, but you’re fuckin’ over nine other girls who are tryin’ to win right now.
lines.zh: : Noriko，回你那桌去。我知道你太善良了，不可能不帮我，可你现在正在坑另外九个想赢的女生。

lines.en: : But you need me the most, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 但你才是最需要我的那个，Yumi。

lines.en: : Only cause I ain’t got the faintest fuckin’ idea of what I’m doin’ over here.
lines.zh: : 只是因为我在这里连他妈的自己在干什么都一无所知。

lines.en: scene poolcook26
: I’m not talking about cooking.
lines.zh: : 我说的不是做饭。

lines.en: : I...ain’t sure what you’re talkin’ about then.
lines.zh: : 那我……不知道你在说什么了。

lines.en: : I’m not really sure either. I just feel like you could use a friend right now. So if my floor has to lose a point over it, oh well. Let’s make an omelet together.
lines.zh: : 其实我也不太确定。我只是觉得你现在需要一个朋友。所以如果我这层楼要为此丢一分，那也无所谓。我们一起做煎蛋卷吧。

lines.en: : I don’t want to do any of the egg stuff, though. I’ll cut the vegetables.
lines.zh: : 不过蛋的部分我可不想碰。我来切蔬菜。

lines.en: : Uh-oh! It looks like Yumi’s in shock due to Noriko’s sudden but expected kindness!
lines.zh: : 哎呀糟了！看来 Yumi 被 Noriko 突然但意料之中的善良震慑住了！

lines.en: : Only she would walk away from a free win! This martyr complex can’t escape even the culinary world! Is there nothing sacred to her besides compassion?!
lines.zh: : 也只有她会放弃白送的胜利！这种殉道者情结连厨艺界都逃不过！对她来说，除了悲悯之心，还有什么东西是神圣的？！

lines.en: : Do you love me yet? Or do I need to keep trying?
lines.zh: : 你现在爱上我了吗？还是我需要继续努力？

lines.en: : I kind of hate you.
lines.zh: : 我有点讨厌你。

lines.en: : Really? Why?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？为什么？

lines.en: : Because you never fuckin’ leave me alone and it’s irritating as hell.
lines.zh: : 因为你他妈的从来不肯放过我，烦死人了。

lines.en: : So the same reasons you “hate” Sensei?
lines.zh: : 所以和你「讨厌」Sensei 是同样的理由？

lines.en: : Yumi, you’ve been holding those peppers for like five minutes straight. It’s time to put them down.
lines.zh: : Yumi，那些青椒你已经举了整整五分钟了。该放下了。

lines.en: : I don’t think I can move my hands. They’re locked up. These peppers are a part of me now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我的手动不了了。它们锁死了。这些青椒现在是我的一部分了。

lines.en: scene poolcook27
: Attention, world. I have completed the pink one’s omelet for her. The second floor can thank me later, seeing as most of them are not currently-
lines.zh: : 全体注意。我已经替粉色那位把她的煎蛋卷做好了。二楼回头再谢我吧，因为他们大部分人现在都不在——

lines.en: : BZZZZT! Omelet advisors are not allowed to do the cooking! That’s a technical foul against floor two!
lines.zh: : 哔哔哔！煎蛋卷顾问不允许亲自下厨！二楼技术犯规！

lines.en: : Tch! If only there was an omelet advisor advisor.
lines.zh: : 啧！要是有一个煎蛋卷顾问的顾问就好了。

lines.en: scene black
: Aaaand gimme that!
lines.zh: : 好啦，给我那个！

lines.en: : Wha- don’t fuckin’ touch me! The fuck you think you’re doin?!
lines.zh: : 什——别他妈碰我！你他妈在干什么？！

lines.en: : What?! You said your hands were stuck! I’m just giving you a little help.
lines.zh: : 什么？！你说你的手僵住了！我只是帮你一把。

lines.en: : Then why the fuck are you still holding onto one?!
lines.zh: : 那你他妈为什么还抓着其中一个不放？！

lines.en: : Oh, that’s just because I love you.
lines.zh: : 哦，那只是因为我爱你。

lines.en: : Fucking leave me alone! Jesus!
lines.zh: : 他妈的离我远点！天啊！

lines.en: scene poolcook28
: Oooookay! Well, now that the competition has come to a close and the mystery judge we pulled off the street has tasted the only omelet that was finished today...
lines.zh: : 好嘞！那么，比赛已经结束，我们从街上拉来的神秘评委也品尝了今天唯一一份完成的煎蛋卷……

lines.en: : It is time for her to weigh in. On one omelet.
lines.zh: : 现在是她发表意见的时候了。就一份煎蛋卷。

lines.en: scene poolcook29
: A single omelet.
lines.zh: : 单独一份煎蛋卷。

lines.en: : That’s it.
lines.zh: : 就这些。

lines.en: : Because Noriko does not understand loyalty.
lines.zh: : 因为 Noriko 根本不懂什么叫忠诚。

lines.en: : I think I understand loyalty too well! It’s a major factor holding me back from the greatness I know I am capable of.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我是太懂忠诚了！它是拖累我无法触及我所知道的那个伟大自我的主要因素。

lines.en: : Well I sure wish I could have seen some of that today!
lines.zh: : 那我今天真希望我能看到哪怕一点点啊！

lines.en: : You did! You saw my loyalty to Yumi. I would give my life for her.
lines.zh: : 你看到了啊！你看到了我对 Yumi 的忠诚。我愿意为她献出生命。

lines.en: : I often wish you would.
lines.zh: : 我常常希望你献一下。

lines.en: scene poolcook30
: So, Nao-chan! You’ve shown up to a few Dorm Wars thingies now. And I know you can’t speak but, thankfully, there’s not much reason to as today’s victor is pretty obvious.
lines.zh: : 那么，Nao-chan！你已经参加过好几次宿舍战争的活动了。我知道你不能说话，不过幸好也没什么可说的，因为今天的赢家相当明显。

lines.en: : So why don’t you go ahead and show all of our make-believe viewers at home the winner of the first Heaven & Hell competition?
lines.zh: : 那么，请你向家中我们那些假想的观众们，展示一下天堂与地狱第一场比赛的胜者吧？

lines.en: scene poolcook31
: The real winner, please.
lines.zh: : 请指真正的赢家。

lines.en: scene poolcook32
scene poolcook33
: Welp! There you have it, folks. Noriko’s kindness has finally damned us all.
lines.zh: : 好嘞！就是这样，各位。Noriko 的善良终于把我们全给坑了。

lines.en: : We’re down by one point, Uta. Kirin’s next and she’ll make up for it, don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 我们只落后一分，Uta。下一个是 Kirin，她会补回来的，别担心。

lines.en: scene poolcook34
: Well, I sure hope so! Because we’ve got a ton of competitions left today!
lines.zh: : 我当然希望如此！因为我们今天还有一大堆比赛呢！

lines.en: : And if the second floor is playing from behind the whole time, I’m going to need to take some of Io’s anxiety medication to combat the darkness growing within me!
lines.zh: : 而且如果二楼全程都在追赶，我就得吃点 Io 的抗焦虑药，来对抗我内心滋长的黑暗了！

lines.en: : Can you let go of me now? The thing is over.
lines.zh: : 你能放开我了吗？比赛都结束了。

lines.en: : I’m never letting go of you for as long as I live. That’s just how loyal I am.
lines.zh: : 只要我活着，我就永远不会放开你。我就是这么忠诚。

lines.en: : Up next — Dungeons & Divas! A one on one battle of normies gone nerdy! Chika! Kirin! Which one will top?!
lines.zh: : 接下来——地下城与女王！一场现充变御宅的一对一之战！Chika！Kirin！谁会在上面？！

lines.en: scene poolcook35
: Ah! Uhh...come out on top! That’s...that’s what I meant to say.
lines.zh: : 啊！呃……是胜出！那……那才是我想说的。

lines.en: : Chika 100%%. Kirin couldn’t top to save her life.
lines.zh: : 100%% 是 Chika。Kirin 要命都压不了人。

lines.en: scene poolcook36
: Yes! My thoughts exact-
lines.zh: : 对！我就是这么想——

lines.en: scene poolcook37
: I mean no! Not my thoughts! Go away, stupid Noriko!
lines.zh: : 我是说不对！那不是我的想法！滚开，笨蛋 Noriko！

lines.en: scene black
: But not you, imaginary viewer at home! Because we’ve got a ton left to show you!
lines.zh: : 但不是你，家里那位假想的观众！因为我们还有很多东西要给你看！

lines.en: : But not without changing into more appropriate clothes first!
lines.zh: : 不过在那之前，得先换身更合适的衣服！

lines.en: : Ayane! The sponsors please!
lines.zh: : Ayane！赞助商有请！

lines.en: : Kumon-mi High’s fifth annual Dorm Wars is brought to you in part by the Tsukioka Foundation, the Produce Delivery Administration, and Koi Cafe!
lines.zh: : Kumon-mi 高中第五届宿舍战争由 Tsukioka 财团、农产品配送管理局以及 Koi Cafe 联合赞助播出！
